name: Nuviko Videos
readiness_blockers: Music-first task graph must accept music and footage without a fabricated narration or TTS request.
A clip compositor must bind the beat timeline, 95–105% motion and the required fade/blur/brightness transition to its actual render.
Vocal lyrics need the canonical music_lyrics word/mask contract; instrumental excerpts require an explicit not-applicable caption route.
The music-first delivery contract must map the accepted 1080×1920@30 Short and Bradley Hand Bold vocal-caption recipe, inspect the actual host font face, and bind measured output/fragment evidence.

caption_font_source.verification: Inspect the actual font face/hash on the render host.
